Today, the platform covers 18 international languages and receives a monthly flow of more than 15,000 visits from foreign users , who use the same scales and calculators made available to the community.

textoCompleto:
Welcome to Premium

PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION

Your subscription has been received. You are now part of the Premium experience of Nursing Calculators.

Congratulations on your subscription
From now on, your Premium access has been contracted and you can enjoy an expanded area of the platform, developed for nursing professionals.

Subscription processing may take a few minutes.

After completing the payment, there may be a short interval until the provider confirms the transaction, the system processes that confirmation, and your Premium access is updated. Don't worry : wait a few minutes before concluding that there was a problem.

Confirming your Premium access...

We are verifying the subscription confirmation. You do not need to make a new payment.

1. Payment confirmation
The payment provider sends the confirmation to our system.

2. Subscription processing
The system records the status of your subscription and updates the commercial authorization.

3. Content release
After the update, Premium access will be recognized when you enter the protected areas.

If access takes too long
If Premium still does not appear after a few minutes, do a clear the browser cache , log out, and log in again . This forces a new reading of your subscription status.

What you unlocked
A study and reference area designed to make access to nursing knowledge more practical.

More than 60 scales
Nursing care scales to support assessment, study, and professional practice.

More than 20 practice tests
Questions to review content and train nursing knowledge.

Educational content
Materials organized with a simple, direct, and quick methodology to facilitate review.

Various calculators
Calculation and reference tools to support studies and professional routines.

International platform
The content has been structured to serve nursing professionals and students in different countries.

Nursing community
A space designed to bring together professionals, students, and nursing knowledge.

THE HISTORY OF THE PROJECT

Created in 2025 to bring nursing closer around the world
The website was created in 2025 with a long-term goal: to become a channel 100% exclusive to bring together the global nursing community , concentrating tools, scales, calculators, educational content, and learning spaces on a single platform.

Today, the platform covers 18 international languages and receives a monthly flow of more than 15,000 visits from foreign users , who use the same scales and calculators made available to the community.

18

international languages

15,000+

foreign visits per month

A platform built for nursing
Premium expands access, but the purpose of the platform remains the same: to facilitate access to nursing knowledge.

Practicality
Tools organized for simple and quick reference and review.

Responsibility
Nursing content should be used with attention, clinical context, and professional responsibility.

Community
An experience created to connect nursing across different languages and countries.

YOUR ACCESS

Your Premium is being prepared
Continue browsing normally. Once the confirmation is processed, the Premium areas will automatically recognize your subscription.
